notes.title: 1.0.13 - small patch
notes.notes: *Fixed a bug with +ammo capacity mod and reloads

notes.title: 1.0.8 - small patch
notes.notes:
Fixed items overlapping beastiary when opened from shop's equip tab
 Beastiary is now only accessible after the player completes a run having successfully beaten at least one stage
 Fixed anvil not showing correct stats for fire wand
 Fixed a bug that may not allow sacrifices to unlock

notes.title: 1.0.7 - A bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where under certain conditions a summon could have been spawned off screen and tanked an enemy for an extremely long time without anyone being able to target it.

notes.title: 1.0.2 - Small qol and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Added reset game speed toggle in options
 Fixed bag slots being able to be increased above limit stated
 Fixed units showing up as incorrect tier in some situations
 Fixed crash when attempting to manually use a chemset

notes.title: 0.5.5 small QOL update
notes.notes:
Boar damage lowered by 30%
 Fixed some bosses not scaling hp after 22
 Fixed a bug with heavy grain constantly giving damage without removing it
 Loot now arranged by worth
 Added sell price label on loot
 Fixed crosshair not showing correct accuracy
 Fixed spell aoe not increasing icemage's primary spell size

notes.title: 0.5.0 A little content and some changes.
notes.notes:
New things

 Added an unlockable hero
 Level 20 boss


New Upgrades available

 implemented written bounties
 implemented spare bodies
 implemented extra roll upgrade
 implemented recruit charisma
 implemented equip discount
 implemented sharper tips


Changes

 Reaper's Magazine nerfed from +5/+5 to +3/+3
 Fix clicking on talent that Is purchased saying "not enough points"
 fix results menu to say talent points
 Grenade boss weakened slightly
 Autopilot is now enabled by default
 Tweaked post 22 scaling to lower damage scaling but increase enemy hp / armor scaling. Scaling is a temporary measure while there is no new enemies after wave 21, just so that people don't go on forever.

notes.title: 0.3.0 - Too many changes to list
notes.notes:
There have been a lot of changes. I'm only going to list the biggest changes to gameplay.


 Removed the illumination mechanic
 Units are now configurable (targeting zones and target priority)
 Added unique boss relic drops
 Added potions

notes.title: 0.1.5 Balance changes and assets
notes.notes:
Still a bit to go.


 Fixed relic not applying scaling qualities
 Equipment shop now always rolls at least one weapon
 Boar movement speed nerf
 Apothecary cheers duration buff 2 > 8
 Poise breaker gale damage nerf 5 > 1
 Fixed bug with alchemist synergy not displaying buff indicator
 Fixed Sentinel's burning oil not showing up on screen
 Added burst rifle model
 Added burst pistol model
 Added sniper rifle model
 Added increased damage to air gunmod model
 Added increased magazine size gunmod model
 Added increased range gunmod model
 Burst pistol change: Now fires off entire magazine once trigger is pulled
 Didn't even notice that the smg had no outline

notes.title: 0.1.4 alpha - Broken arrow and other small changes
notes.notes:
Nerfed aoe of grenade item
 Enemies that spawn should now be more varied
 Fixed uncommon bug that stopped the player from starting the game
 Fixed bug with extremely slowed units moving fast
 Fixed ui bug with unit's weapon / relic indicator completely disappearing
 Fixed ui bug where unit's slots would continue blinking if an item was sold
 Fixed bug with third boss being able to be forced off the screen, resulting in a soft lock
 Added broken arrow relic
 Nerfed UplandHunter's Doki gold 4 > 2

notes.title: 0.1.3 Game breaking bug fix
notes.notes:
Healing bar now has a max of what can be afforded
 Flare item / spell uses a better projectile asset
 Fixed gamebreaking bug with serialization of multiple scenes
 Added wrench model for constructor repair synergy

notes.title: 0.1.2 Some UI updates and bug fixes
notes.notes:
The UI is still ugly, but:

New card purchasing effect
New effect on bars filling up in upgrade tab
Granular repair bar in castle menu
Gave shock shaman targetting zones and priority
Might have fixed an index error in aoe trigger system
Fixed bug with summons dying
Fixed some UI bugs
Fixed regression with rotation of pooled objects
Fixed footman's axe potentially being behind the camera
Enemy necro's summons now point in the correct direction
Some new perk icons

notes.title: 0.1.1 Coffee and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Just a small patch.


 Added shop effect that goes from purchased card to unit or equipment.
 Fixed bug where you can spam start on the main menu and prevent the game from ever starting
 Added shop effect when things are sold
 Added coffee relic
 Added bullet casings ejecting from assault rifle / pump/ and smg
 Small effect on grid squares
 Small pulsing effect on unit equipment when highlighting weapons or relics
 Tooltips for units on placement grid now don't overlap placement section
 Fixed bug with tooltip not working after losing once
 Fixed bug with cursor disappearing if perk chosen while autopilot was enabled
